title: Mixed Event — Singing Among the Cherry Blossoms

meta.Outline: Ichika continues her singing practice with Nene in the hopes of improving as much as possible for Shiho. She decides to try performing on the street in order to gain more confidence, but what unexpected encounter awaits her there...?!

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for seeing me again, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, um... Thank you too, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, would you like to start with some warm-ups...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Lead the way...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to say it, but this doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... You might want to relax a little more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And it may also help to sing more from your stomach to make sure your throat stays open.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, from my stomach...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, that's it.
You sound much better than before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see, like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Kusanagi.
That helped quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it still feels like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm singing with everything I have. I don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe it's just a matter of confidence, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Confidence...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
The first time I heard you sing, you seemed to sort of have doubts about your own abilities.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And even now, it seems like there's a small part of you somewhere that still feels that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Doubts about my abilities...
You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't worry. I was the same way, so I know how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? You were...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something I did a long time ago during a play I was in made me completely lose confidence in myself...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No matter how many times I tried to sing after that, it felt like there was something missing the same way you feel right now, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So how were you able to overcome that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remembered why it was so fun to sing, and everything felt much better after that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why it was so fun to sing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. I'm still not even sure if I've fully returned to being my old self...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that feeling of something being missing has vanished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However, I also don't think it's a good idea to dwell on it too much. That kind of obsession could end up making things worse.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Experiencing that moment when you feel like singing is fun will probably help you the most.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay. I understand...
Thanks, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, shall we start from the top?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, please!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi!
Your voice sounds amazing today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Does it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I can even tell through my drumming. I'm not sure how to put it into words, but it felt like we played so well because your voice sounded so light on its feet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. It's all thanks to Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You've been getting advice from her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have, and she's been helping me practice even when it gets pretty late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's great!
Your hard work is really paying off too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
We did sound pretty good just now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(All this praise is so encouraging.
I'm glad I asked Kusanagi for her help.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And I want to touch someone's heart with my music, like they did with mine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's why I have to get better...
I want to become a pro and reach more people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So that my music can really get them going too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My singing is nowhere near that level yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to get better and really learn how to perform with everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (How do I move up from here...?)
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'm staying behind to practice with Miku some more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great job, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Thanks, Ichi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't work too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See you at school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right, see you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry for making you stay, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, don't worry about that. There's something you want to talk about, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong? You can talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
How can I become more confident?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: More confident?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
I've definitely gotten much better at singing lately thanks to all the help I've been getting.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you have improved quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But it still feels like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Someone else told me that it could be a matter of having confidence in myself, but I don't know how to feel more confident...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why I'm asking you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My mind is telling me to just keep practicing, but I feel like there's more to it than just that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
You've been doing very well in practice too, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you still feel like something is missing, it may help to actually sing in front of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like in public...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some people practice their hearts out and even sound great, but can't quite produce the same results when it matters most.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By singing and playing in front of people, you'll naturally become more and more confident in your abilities.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You may be right. We haven't actually played in front of anyone yet, have we...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But where or when can we do that...?
The School Festival is too far off and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then how about a street performance?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're bound to receive a confidence boost by learning to sing in front of complete strangers, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right, there's usually someone performing on Main Street too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But can I do what they do...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure you can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. I'm a little nervous, but I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I'm glad I asked you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'll be rooting for you.
The next day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is this a good spot...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's no one performing here today for a change...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm starting to get nervous. What should I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(No, I'll be fine...
Just sing the way you do during practice and remember what Kusanagi taught you.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku's cheering me on too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Okay, be brave...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(W-Wait...
Something's wrong. One more time. Just breathe...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My voice... I can't sing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I'm usually much louder than this.
What's happening...?!)

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student
rows.Line: Wait, seriously? That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Male High School Student
rows.Line: Hahaha. And my teacher got so mad...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Right, they're all within earshot of my voice...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But what if I start getting weird looks? What if they start laughing...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, I almost feel too scared of playing my guitar too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to get better. I need to keep singing...)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Hey, remember that place we had lunch at the other day?

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! That place was so good! We have to go again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Ah, thank you so much for calling me back! Oh, yes! It's about that...!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: R-Really?! Thank you very much! I'm looking forward to doing more business with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They're not even laughing, let alone listening...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No one cares about my music...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I should stop for today...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I couldn't even get through one song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (How is it that those other people can perform out there the way they do?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho's been playing in front of complete strangers for some time now too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought that I'd gotten better after working with Kusanagi, but I'm still nowhere near Shiho's level...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I don't find a way to get better, at this rate...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... It's a Miku song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Such a cute but beautiful voice too...
I wonder who's singing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Wait, is that Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Isn't she in Shiho's class...?
She seems like the shy type but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She's singing in a fairly crowded place too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She looks so confident and isn't hesitating at all.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Whoa, she's an awesome singer!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
I've seen her here and there lately.
I think she sings at events and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Really? Might be worth checking out!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All these people passing by are stopping to watch her sing. They all just completely captivated by her voice.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Everybody, thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
That was great!
Please come sing for us again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I will!
Bye, for now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Azusawa...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, um... Hoshino?
You're Shiho's friend, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sorry for bothering you like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Azusawa, I was blown away by the way you sang just now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Hehe. You're making me blush a little.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But you were so incredible, and looked so confident.
Do you always perform here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do. Well, I just started doing this, so I can't say "always" or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I usually sing as part of a group, but I'm also the one with the least experience...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone else either already has musical experience or has been doing this for years, so they're much better than I am.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm doing everything I can to catch up to them, which is why I'm singing in public or joining events by myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so amazing, Azusawa. I can't say enough about your drive and initiative...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a dream that I want to come true so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A dream?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. My friend, the one that's in my group, wants to put on a really big event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An event so big, it gets everyone watching... No, everybody involved happy and excited to be there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For now, I have to do what I can to catch up to everyone, but we definitely will someday...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's great...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Speaking of which, aren't you in a band with Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am, but we're also just starting out. Except Shiho. She's been playing bass since she was in elementary school, so she's very good now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's so focused when it comes to music and even wants to become a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A pro? That's so cool!
Do you want to be a pro too, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, there's no way I can ever be that good. There are just so many great musicians out there too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I want to help make Shiho's dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho's?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Even if it's not entirely possible for me to become one, I can at least help her get close to the level she wants to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's always teaching me so much, and I've been taking away from her own practice time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why I want to get better. Then I can help her play to her heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's wonderful! Your dream sounds so nice too, Hoshino...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure that I'd call it a dream, but I'd be happy if it came true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hoshino? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I haven't been feeling all that confident lately, and even tried to perform in public for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wasn't really able to play anything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was so scared that my voice would sound weird and ended up not being able to sing at all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I couldn't even make it through one song...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then you're just like me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In the beginning, I made a lot of mistakes, had equipment issues and felt like nothing was ever going to go well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But my teammates all came together and told me that they believe in me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So to make sure that I don't disappoint them, and to catch up to them, I'm practicing as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure Shiho feels the same way about you, Hoshino. That has to be why she's willing to teach you so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quit apologizing and let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do want to get better, but together... With all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right...
She did say that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If I'm going to actually help make her dream come true, I need to stop feeling sorry for myself and stand back up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Azusawa.
I'll keep doing what I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'm glad I could help.
The next day
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And... There...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Let's give it one more try...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But the crowd's as big as ever.
I can't help but feel a little nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I still feel like I can't sing...
Is today going to end the same way...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (With me not getting any closer to Shiho's level...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So to make sure that I don't disappoint them and to catch up to them, I'm practicing as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure Shiho feels the same way about you. That has to be why she's willing to teach you so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(I have to change.
They won't hear me at this rate...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho's already taught me so much, so I need to keep getting better and better!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need...!)
song00003_off_f

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need my song to be heard!)

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hm? Is someone doing a show?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Whoa, listen!
She has an awesome voice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(They're all watching...
They're listening to my song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh no, my hands are starting to shake...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I have to...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want them to hear my song!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want everyone passing by to hear my music!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Put everything into the last chorus and verse...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Stay focused through the outro and...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My hands are shaking and my legs are so wobbly. I can feel my heart pounding throughout my entire body too. It's so loud...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But that was fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never knew it felt so good to sing like this in front of other people...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, everyone! Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
That was a great song!
We should be thanking you!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
So awesome!
Come back soon!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*... I will!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd like to do that again...
bgm_area00001
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright, I think we're all ready.
Honami, count us in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whooaaaa...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, that was amazing!
Like, more amazing than before!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right! Your voice was so powerful but also beautiful. It felt like I was being immersed in it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't believe you improved this much in so little time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like all your hard work is paying off, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It is.
I have you to thank, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hard work?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Were you doing extra sessions with Miku or something? Please, tell us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What do you think, Ichika?
Shall we tell them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll let you decide, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then it'll be our little secret.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! Ichi's not allowed to hide anything from me...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Settle down, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But she really has been getting better and better. I need to do the same and keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was worth it, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so. I was about to say that you might even be stage ready.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Shiho. That means so much coming from you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It does?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. My dream is to reach the same level that you want to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want you to be able to play to your heart's content, so I'll keep trying my best...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you...
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student A
rows.Line: Hey, she's pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've seen her around lately.
Maybe she's in a band?

rows.Speaker: Female High School Student A
rows.Line: She could be. Let's go watch!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, those girls stopped by to watch.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (In that case, I should...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I should make sure they have as much fun as I do...!)

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Wow! She's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Nice! A street performance!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (More and more people are stopping by now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Some are even saying that my songs are good or even great...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That makes me so happy, and makes this so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll keep practicing so that I can reciprocate this feeling with more and more people.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I think I'll call it a day...

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Aww, no more?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I thought I should get going and...

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Wait, could you play just a little longer? I didn't catch the beginning so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Yeah, come on! Encore!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, sure.
How does one more sound...?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many people stopped by today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad that I've really been able to reach some of them too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I doubt that I'm making anyone's heart stir yet but... I'd be happy if my singing at least made an impression on someone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that cherry blossom tree...
It's already in full bloom!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I'll go take a look.
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Such a nice breeze...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We used to come here for picnics, I think...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd lay out a big tarp, Saki's mom would bring us all snacks and... Oh, that was when Honami started developing a taste for apple pies too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There was also that time I ended up outside the park after looking so hard for a four-leaf clover, and made everyone look for me instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. So many memories...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After we decided to form a band and play Miku songs, I came here to listen to her music and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Her music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It brought us all back together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki couldn't go to school because she was in the hospital, while I started to lose touch with Shiho and Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As much as I wanted the four of us to be friends again, I couldn't do anything back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All I could do was watch as Shiho, Honami and I drifted further and further away from each other.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That was when I met Miku in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If she didn't ask me to play that one time, we would've stayed estranged from one another.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And Miku was the one that made me realize what my true feelings were...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She asked me about them and helped figure out what they were...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was able to tell Honami after that and we finally started to come back together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We couldn't have done it without you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm always singing and playing her songs too...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've been listening to her songs since I was little, but I think it goes beyond simply liking it...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku's songs have a special place in my heart.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want to keep making new memories. I want her songs to be there every step of the way.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You deserve to hear this too...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You've really improved, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks. I've been practicing quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So your "secret training" with Ichika's been paying off?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? I'm not sure I understand...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm sorry, Saki's under the impression that you and Ichika have been practicing in secret.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that why Ichika's singing voice has changed so much?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Her songs have much more power behind them, and her voice sounds more elegant now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That would never happen under normal circumstances. So what did you two do, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, nothing. All she did was ask me for some advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She must've arrived at the answer to whatever was bothering her all by herself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. You've become such an important mentor to her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? I-I have?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You worked so hard on learning how to help the girls...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Is that true, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: L-Luka...! No one needs to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I do think that you've become a good mentor. Especially compared to when you just met Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry too, Miku. I didn't mean to tease or anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I just never took a step back to think about it is all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I always thought that words like mentor, senior and such suited you two more.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Luka's so mature but also really nice, and MEIKO's so helpful...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm wondering if I can actually fill your shoes... What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You don't have to fill our shoes, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You can help others in so many different ways.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Someone may find MEIKO to be the most helpful, while others might be more compatible with someone else. In Ichika's case, you're her ideal mentor.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no real right answer. You should do what you feel is right, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Being concerned about someone and doing everything you can to help them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what it's all about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've really grown, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Thanks, you two...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, I believe she's just arrived...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... Miku, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds urgent.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We should let them talk.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I can wait until you're finished...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Actually, your timing couldn't be better.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. We were just about to go tune our instruments, so don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ah, I see what they're doing...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's very thoughtful of them to do so...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome, Ichika.
Are you alone today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
There's something that I'd like to talk to you about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
Thank you for lending me an ear the other day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
I'm guessing that things went well after that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They did, and I couldn't have done it without you, Miku. Which is why I want you to hear the difference...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
I'll get ready to play too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Actually, Miku...
If it's alright with you, I'd like you to come to my world this time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your world?
I don't see why not...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's something I'd like you to see.
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, cherry blossoms...!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I saw them on my way home after I did a street performance and thought that I should show you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Thank you very much. They might even be the most beautiful cherry blossoms I've ever seen.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because we're seeing them together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Together? Us?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
When you see things with someone you care about, it becomes more special, more beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That includes cherry blossoms, stars and even classrooms... You end up creating precious memories with the people that mean the most to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're one of those people, Miku. It has to be why these cherry blossoms look so beautiful now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The last time I was here, I sang one of your songs and felt like I needed to see you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just... So much has happened since we first met...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. You're right.
So much has changed since then too.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. I never would've dreamed of the four of us playing in a band together like this back then...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't even think that we'd be able to be friends again to be honest...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you helped us reconnect with each other. We couldn't have come this far without you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I asked you to come here today to play a song for you that says just that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'm a little embarassed to play your own song in front of you but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Don't worry.
Please, let me hear your song.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Her voice is so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ever since I met Ichika, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She looked so sad the first time I saw her.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She wanted to be friends with the others again so bad, but didn't know how...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But when the four of them played together in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They were sort of all over the place back then...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But their music made them realize just how much they all mean to each other. They realized that they all wanted the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They argued and fought a little after that too, but it didn't end there...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichika and I started a band!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It all started with Ichika and Saki.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ichika's expression slowly started to change after that every time I saw her in SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What started as I can't turned into I'll try. She looked so determined.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The next time I saw her in SEKAI after that...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miku! Luka! Sorry for barging in! We have to master this song so that Shiho will join our band!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry if we're asking too much, but this is our chance to have Shiho join! Could you please help us practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They were so adamant about practicing as hard as they could to convince Shiho into joining their band.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Luckily, they managed to reach her and became a happy group of four.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And then...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all amazing, and very dear to me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's why I want us all to be in this band together. Maybe there's something else that could bring us back together, but this is what I want.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ichika managed to find her true feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And after Ichika told Honami how she really felt, their song was born.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There were times when they strayed from their path and each other, but they finally got their band back together.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And Ichika...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's taking big steps on her own now.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (All I can do is sing for her...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But if that's my way of helping, then I want to keep doing what I can for her and the girls.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That was wonderful, Ichika.
Your hard work's really paid off.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm sure you'll be able to touch everyone's hearts with this song.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It always feels like you end up giving me the most amount of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Also, Miku...
I asked you to come here today because there's something I'd like to tell you...
Hm? Ichika...?
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Hanasato? Azusawa...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Sorry, Miku! Could you hide for a second?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, yeah...!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What brings you here? Are you on your way home from something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Minori and I were out doing a little shopping.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then we started hearing this beautiful singing voice, and we came to see who it was...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does this mean that you were the one singing that Miku song, Ichika?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes. It was me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! I never knew you were so good at singing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...? Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika! Would you mind if I sang with you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: T-Together...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Your singing made me want to sing too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
How about we all sing together?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hanasato, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sure, okay.
Let's sing!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I guess I should head home now that I've finished delivering a change of clothes to the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I was at least hoping to see dad today but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to get back to cleaning up our new song. After that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How could I have gotten our meeting time wrong?! I'm a future star for pete's sake!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Gasp*...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was close. We almost just headbutted each other... Please accept my apology!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no... I'm okay so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Wait, now's not the time...!
I have to get ready for the show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, if you'll excuse me!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That was strange.
He was so loud too...
Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is this...? A Miku song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, there are people singing in the park.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wonder how many are singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (They're singing in unison and their voices all seem to complement one another...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This is nice...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane, Ichika!
Would it be okay if we sang one more song?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes. I was about to ask the same thing.
How about you, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! This is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right.
Do you have something in mind, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, before that! Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would you mind calling me by my first name?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I never found the right time to ask you, but I feel like we've gotten to know each other a lot better by singing together like this so...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, um... Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's okay. You can call me the same way Saki does!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Then...
Can you do the same for me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...! Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So... Minori, Kohane...
Friends?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yup, friends!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is great!
We became much, much closer just like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
How about we try that Miku song everyone's been talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, that one. Sure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The one everyone's been... Oh, got it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Practicing with everyone and doing street performances is fun too, but this is really something else.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never knew that singing could be fun and enjoyed in so many different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't ever want to stop...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That person... Are they listening to us sing?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Then let's put on a good show for them.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, they left, but I think they were smiling at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe we're not quite there yet. I need to keep practicing and keep getting better...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Someday, they'll hear us sing again...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See you tomorrow at school!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, see you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That was really lovely, Ichika.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
Your music just helped me become friends with Minori and Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <My music?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
I've talked with them before about it and I even met Kohane while she was singing one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your songs have such incredible powers...
Not only did they help bring my old friends back together, they're helping me make new ones as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been able to meet so many new faces, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So... Thank you.
I'm so glad I met you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Oh, stop.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You were the one that found out what your true feelings were, and you made it here all on your own.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Just keep cherishing those feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My feelings...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
So that we can all stay together as one...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: These cherry blossoms really are beautiful, aren't they...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They are...>
